note: Rustic campground strung along the south bank of the East Fork of the Black River, with a canoe and kayak hand launch; the sites sit under trees back from the water. Generators are not allowed in Black River State Forest campgrounds. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + 2023 campground brochure read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). 24 non-electric sites, vault toilets, hand pump, no showers/flush/dump (dump at Castle Mound), reservation required confirmed. Riverview confirmed on imagery (pads under canopy behind a tree band). Generator ban added to note. Season (manual) conflicts with a second line on the page and its closing date is off by a few days.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview CONFIRMED (no change). The brochure map strings sites 101-124 along the south bank of the East Fork of the Black River. On Esri imagery (160 m half-width at 44.4218,-90.6748) the river is about 50 m wide here (riverfront-sized, not a creek), and the site clearings sit roughly 15-50 m back from the bank, but every pad is under continuous canopy with an unbroken band of trees between the pads and the water; no pad is on open ground to the shore. A view value, as stored. Site photos are on GoingToCamp (refuses), so pads could not be checked from the ground.

SEASON (manual, not overwritten): the page says 'open from May 1 through the Monday after the second weekend of October' (2026: Oct 12; 2027: Oct 11 - stored closes 10-16 is a few days late), but the same section also says 'This campground is open from mid-April through mid-October'. Conflicting official lines on one page; reviewer may want closes 10-11/10-12 and a season note naming both.

GENERATORS: the forest's 2023 campground brochure rules say 'Use of generators is not permitted' (applies to all Black River State Forest campgrounds). Added to the note; a motorhome relying on a generator should know.

WEBSITE: https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/StateForests/blackriver (live) -> https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/StateForests/blackriver/recreation/camping (the camping page with the East Fork section); keep https://wisconsin.goingtocamp.com. Phone 715-284-4103 confirmed.
